lorebook.editor.promptSpot.help: Prompt order lists entries the way they reach the prompt. Every entry placed before the character definitions comes before every entry placed after them, whatever their Order numbers, and Order only ranks entries that share a spot. Depth entries go into the chat itself, deepest first, and Outlets go wherever their outlet macro is. This assumes your preset keeps the Before block above the After block, as the built-in presets do. Dragging an entry changes its Order, so it moves only among entries at the same spot.

ui.chat.summarypopover.autoCombineDescri: Once there are more summaries outside chapters than this, all but the newest become one chapter, using your combine prompt. Chapters are kept as written, so older events are not summarised over and over. It runs right after a new summary is saved, so prompt caching is not broken an extra time.
ui.chatSettings.advancedparameterssectio: When the history is too long, drop this many of the oldest messages at once instead of one per reply. The rest of the history then stays the same for several replies, so prompt caching keeps working. Applies to the message limit, the context size, Chat History's Max messages and hidden summarised messages.
Once the chat is longer than this, the oldest message leaves on every reply, so prompt caching cannot reuse the chat history. Turn on Drop Old Messages in Steps below to keep it cached between steps.
Automatic summaries hide what they cover, so keep this at {{count}} or more. A lower limit drops messages between summaries, and each drop re-sends the prompt without its cache.
ui.chatSettings.combatstylesection.narra: Battle narration turns each blow into a line of prose. The built-in local model tells it for free when it is set up; without it, this game's scene model does, with one short request per round. With neither, Marinara writes the lines itself at no cost. The numbers always come from the game.
ui.chatSettings.impersonatesection.resul: Impersonate writes into your message box. Edit it, then send it yourself.

Post it adds the impersonated message to the chat right away, as if you sent it. Message draft writes it into your message box instead, so you can read and edit it first. A draft saves nothing and runs no agents, trackers or character reply until you send it. For one time only, use the Quick replies menu or type /impersonate_draft or /impersonate_post.
Impersonate posts your message to the chat right away.

ui.presets.sectionstab.recentMessagesHel: How many of the newest messages this sends; Chat History sends the rest. Sections placed between the two markers, such as the scene's location or who is present, sit right before these messages, so the model keeps them in mind, while the older messages stay a fixed start that providers can cache. Depth entries count chat messages only; entries deeper than this number land among the older messages.
